name: The Lantern Fish Constellation Garden
description: A garden where bioluminescent fish swim through the air like living lanterns, creating constellation patterns above a tranquil pond.
prompt: A magical garden at twilight where dozens of bioluminescent lantern fish swim through the air like living stars. Their translucent bodies glow with soft blue and green light, weaving intricate constellation patterns above a perfectly still pond. Water lilies with tiny LED lights float on the surface, mirroring the celestial display above. Ancient stone lanterns line pathways made of crushed moonstone. Ethereal atmosphere, cool color palette, fantasy realism with luminous details.
caption: Tonight's sky show features swimming fish and constellation trails - no telescope required! 🐟✨
